allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Young history buff Kevin can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being, they've purloined a map charting all of the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon, Robin Hood and King Agamemnon before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

facts.title: Time Bandits

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Armed with a cosmic blueprint of time's greatest cracks, can this unruly crew outrun the Supreme Being while plundering history's treasures?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When six rogue dwarfs burst from his bedroom closet with a stolen cosmic map, young history buff Kevin gets swept into an era-hopping heist across the centuries, pursued by their former master, the Supreme Being.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting, humorous, and delightfully brisk, this inventive fantasy offers an engaging adventure great for friends or family.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Terry Gilliam turns a fantastical time-travel romp into a witty, fast-paced adventure that tumbles delightfully through myth and legend.
